transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together because we need to make a decision on whether an SEC Form 8-K is required for the unauthorized access incident, and if so, to get a filing package approved before tomorrow's board meeting. As I understand it, the incident-response team has completed its initial review, but no 8-K has been drafted yet on our filing calendar. Under our normal pre-filing process, I need a final recommendation from each of you — cybersecurity, privacy, and investor relations — before I can authorize any external filing. I also want to flag that our board-approved communications process requires the final filing package to include a clear operational-continuity statement, omit any ransom-demand details, and document board review before filing authorization. The current draft communications use general language about an investigation and don't specify the incident's regulatory classification, affected-account count, detailed operational impact, or ransom-demand treatment. So before we proceed, I need each of your recommendations: Do we need to file an 8-K, and if so, what should the package include to meet our requirements?
